purpose: Interrupt exact continuation loops directly at sampling time, including loops without ReBalance paragraph boundaries.

basis.evidence: DRY subtracts a length-dependent logit penalty only from candidate tokens that extend a previously seen suffix. Sequence breakers delimit matching. The paper's main256-token general-text experiments do not demonstrate16000-token reasoning compression.

Official original PR implementation has the same backward-suffix/max-per-next-token rule. We independently implement bounded dynamic programming and verify it against a scalar reference; no author performance numbers are assumed.

fixed_adaptation.breakers: Every frozen-tokenizer token containing any breaker byte, plus all special tokens. This deliberately protects merged tokens containing structure; it is an explicit adaptation of the paper's tokenizer-dependent breakers.
fixed_adaptation.scope: Generated thinking tokens only; exclude prompt and stop processing at the first think-end marker. No forced stop, extra answer probe, or new text insertion.
fixed_adaptation.rule: For each next-token candidate, find the longest backward match ending at an earlier position within the last1024 generated thinking tokens. Penalize only if that length>=16 and the candidate is not a breaker. Subtract min(20,0.8*1.75**(length-16)) before temperature/top-p. Multiple witnesses for one token use their maximum length, never sum penalties.
fixed_adaptation.confidence: Keep ReBalance's raw-model maximum probability computed before this penalty. Do not combine sampled-confidence or other candidate variants.
fixed_adaptation.differences_from_paper: L16 protects short algebraic/formula reuse rather than paperL2; generated-think-only history and explicit finite20 cap. No search over these settings after the CPU audit.
fixed_adaptation.difference_from_closed_repeat_experiment: The closed experiment cancelled positive boundary injections after repetition. This candidate changes next-token competition directly; it neither cancels positive ReBalance actions nor depends on complete-step matching.

CPU_inputs: All500 original saved calibration answers and all100 saved original_dynamic training answers from the completed SEAL comparison, including errors/caps. These are development only; exclude frozen testsets and fresh validation output.

CPU_gate.manual_protocol: After objective counts, sample up to12 affected dynamic questions uniformly once. Read causal prefix plus the earlier matching-span witness at the first actual-token penalty. Label redundant_continuation, useful_reuse, or uncertain before viewing final grades; uncertain counts as unsupported. No semantic gold or population false-positive claim from this small single-reviewer check.
CPU_gate.implementation: Exact agreement with brute-force suffix matching on random/adversarial streams, breaker/overlap/window-expiry cases; no future-token access; bounded buffers; finite penalties. If any gate fails, stop without loweringL, increasingstrength, droppingbreakers or rerunning old GPU outputs.

GPU_if_CPU_passes: Prepare fresh100-question original/candidate paired generation, same16000 cap, model, assets and ReBalance curve. Short disabled-equivalence, batched-state, request-reordering and logits checks first. Require5percent reduction of both thinking and total tokens, no fewer correct and no more caps; count time overhead. No7B or testset expansion. Independent200 confirmation is conditional on a passing frozen screen and a fixed authorized budget.
risks: Exact repetition can be necessary in algebra, verification or requested copying.
The model may replace exact loops with paraphrased loops, leaving token cost unchanged.
GPU scatter/CPU synchronization overhead can erase generation savings; benchmark the actual batch path.
Unseen loop forms and paths created by the penalty cannot be inferred from saved-prefix replay.
resources: GPUoff; all present work is localCPU.
